correctness.rationale: The rank-one generator factorization and finite cyclic adjugate identity produce an exact all-dimensional characteristic polynomial. Its first two coefficients prove the Kemeny rational formula and simple zero mode. Direct derivatives prove both reversal boundaries and fixed-budget allocations; all equality cases, rate-zero boundaries and the n=4 exception are covered. The standalone independent-minors verifier passed 845 exact-rational checks. Finite tests are supplemental, not the proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed new object is the joint positive-rate reciprocal chord network-design law, particularly the nonmonotone opposite-rate reversal and exact allocation phase. The pre-existing single-chord formula covers only the b=0 boundary. Relevant 2010 and 2016 primary full texts were compared by hypotheses and implications, not titles. General Kemeny perturbation/forest methods were not claimed as new; residual unindexed-coverage risk persists.
residual_risks: General Kemeny formulas may have been previously specialized to the identical reciprocal directed-ring parameters in literature not indexed or accessible through the conducted searches.
The result is an exact natural network subfamily, not a claim of a general arbitrary-graph perturbation law.

value.rationale: Reciprocal shortcut installation is a natural two-endpoint directed network design decision. The sharp all-order dimension boundary, exact counterintuitive deterioration under every positive symmetric chord, globally optimal rate allocation for a fixed budget, and directional Braess reversal after a calculable opposite-rate threshold directly distinguish beneficial from harmful modifications. The reversal cannot be read from a single-arc formula and motivates the exact two-rate invariant.
